description: Create a new collaborative event checklist (for BBQs, camping, picnics, potlucks, and dinners) with categorized items, quantities, date, location, and host name. Returns a live shareable URL and invite copy.

items.description: List of supply and food items needed

location.description: Optional venue, address, or park landmark

title.description: Event title (e.g. "Saturday BBQ Cookout" or "Family Lake Picnic")

name: create_event_checklist
